source.title: Curcumin-induced HDAC inhibition and attenuation of medulloblastoma growth in vitro and in vivo.
source.status_scope: No relation in the saved Europe PMC correction/version fields; this is not a universal integrity clearance.

identity.animal_formulation: Curcumin dissolved in corn oil; corn-oil vehicle comparator; daily oral gavage
formulation_limits: No nanoparticle or Gemini-Cur delivery used
No purity, catalog/lot, administered concentration or gavage-volume detail

actually_administered_other_agents.name: z-VAD-FMK
actually_administered_other_agents.role: Pan-caspase inhibitor used for mechanistic cell control, 20 µM for 2 h pretreatment then during an additional 8 h with curcumin
actually_administered_other_agents.result: Cleaved caspase-3 signal suppressed; curcumin-associated HDAC4 reduction and HDAC-activity reduction persist. No LDH, organism survival or MVA rescue in this control.

actually_administered_other_agents.name: thymidine
actually_administered_other_agents.role: Cell-cycle synchronization, 2 mM for 18 h before release

actually_administered_other_agents.name: nocodazole
actually_administered_other_agents.role: Prometaphase arrest, 100 nM for 8 h after 3 h release

actually_administered_other_agents.name: G418
actually_administered_other_agents.role: Selection of tdTomato-positive DAOY clones, 500 µg/ml for 2 weeks

actually_administered_other_agents.name: corn oil
actually_administered_other_agents.role: Animal formulation/vehicle, not an independently tested beneficial agent

dose.Smo_Smo_dose: Smo/Smo Methods paragraph states daily gavage from weaning but does not independently restate a numerical dose. Do not silently assign either conflicting xenograft dose.
dose.interpretation: The source supports a curcumin-versus-corn-oil comparison, but an unambiguous reproducible numerical regimen cannot be reconstructed from the published descriptions alone. No presumed typo is corrected.

xenograft.methods_host: Female hairless SCID mice, 5–6 weeks old
xenograft.caption_host: Nude mice in Figure 6A and Supplement 5
xenograft.host_discrepancy: Preserved; do not silently treat the labels as an authenticated identical strain.
xenograft.inoculum: 7 × 10^6 viable DAOY or tdTomato-DAOY cells with Matrigel, subcutaneous
xenograft.allocation_n: Methods 8–12 mice per group; Figure 6A specifies 12/group; supplementary Figure 5 specifies 8/group
xenograft.measurement: Caliper twice weekly; volume = length × width × depth × 0.5; tdTomato images weekly
xenograft.humane_endpoints: Weight loss ≥15% of initial weight or tumor volume ≥2000 mm³
xenograft.reported_volume_caveat: Final control mean 2294 mm³ exceeds the stated volume euthanasia threshold; sampling/removal implementation and per-timepoint denominators are not explained. This is a reporting ambiguity, not evidence of a particular protocol violation.
xenograft.attrition_and_exclusions: No animal-level accounting or per-timepoint at-risk n supplied

Smo_Smo.model: Constitutively active Smoothened expressed in cerebellar granule neuron precursors; spontaneous medulloblastoma model, not BUB1B/MVA
Smo_Smo.end: Clinical manifestation of disease, followed by euthanasia and tumor collection
Smo_Smo.sex: Not reported in the Smo/Smo paragraph; do not inherit female from xenograft hosts
Smo_Smo.survival_limit: Reported lifespan/clinical-symptom humane-endpoint time, not an observed untreated natural-death comparison; no hazard ratio or confidence interval provided.

outcomes.schedule: Daily treatment starts day 30; plotted follow-up through day 91 after implantation
outcomes.effect_description: Tumor growth reduced, not eliminated or reversed to no tumor. tdTomato images (two illustrated animals per arm) corroborate relative tumor burden but are not drug-exposure images.
outcomes.replication_scope: Caption says representative of three independent studies. This is author-reported within-publication repetition; complete per-study animal data are not supplied, and no independent external replication is claimed.

outcomes.kind: separate plotted xenograft trend; nonsignificant reported contrasts
outcomes.schedule: Treatment starts approximately day 30, follow-up to day 64
outcomes.interpretation: All listed P values exceed .05; stars must not be translated into conventional significant thresholds. The lower curcumin trajectory is retained as a trend without claiming demonstrated significance in these contrasts.
outcomes.replication_scope: Caption says representative of two independent studies; no basis to pool automatically with the three main-caption studies or assume five unique studies.

outcomes.interpretation: Longer time to clinical disease/euthanasia in this model. Curves ultimately reach zero; no tumor eradication or cure. No PK, normal-tissue function or MVA endpoint inferred.

outcomes.result: More cleaved caspase-3/PARP, less HDAC4 and phospho-HDAC4/5/7 signal, more acetylated tubulin; GAPDH loading control. HDAC2/3/6 included.
outcomes.limit: One displayed lane per arm; no per-animal quantification, pooling specification or biological n tied to this blot. End-stage tumors were collected at clinical manifestation, potentially at different ages/times; biochemical mediation is not established.

outcomes.model: DAOY plus D283 Med/D341 Med for supplemental protein assays
outcomes.exposure: Main morphology 0/10/20/40 µM for 16 h; LDH0/10/20/40 µM at 8/24 h; cell cycle at 7/24 h; supplemental D283/D341 protein 0/5/10/20/40 µM for 24 h
outcomes.result: Dose/time-related LDH and apoptotic marker increases; G2/M accumulation (10 µM,24 h: reported 74.5% versus 30.8% control). Higher concentrations show a different distribution; authors suggest slippage, but no live lineage tracking proves it.
outcomes.limit: No normal-cell comparative assay in this study. Source Results twice say D431 Med, whereas Methods/native supplements identify D341 Med.

outcomes.exposure: Release with20 µM curcumin or vehicle for 60 min

result.replicates: three independent experiments; cell denominator not stated

outcomes.interpretation: More spindle abnormalities/disordered chromosome alignment. This supports antimitotic injury, not recovered segregation fidelity; no measured normal-MVA harm is inferred.

outcomes.exposure: Assays include5–50 µM; bulk HDAC activity is after 3 h in Methods versus 6 h in Figure 5A caption/Results
outcomes.result: Lower total lysate HDAC activity and HDAC4 protein/phosphorylation, increased acetylated tubulin; HDAC4 cytoplasmic distribution and bulk histone acetylation reported largely unchanged. z-VAD-FMK blocks caspase signal without eliminating HDAC effects.
outcomes.limit: Treated-cell lysate activity is not a purified isoform inhibition/selectivity assay. No HDAC4 genetic rescue, direct binding assay, target-resistance or mediation proof. Other isoform densitometry is not uniformly unchanged (e.g., Figure 5B 25 µM/15 h HDAC2 .57,HDAC7 .55; Supplement 3 D341/50 µM HDAC2 .50), so avoid an absolute HDAC4-only effect claim.

limits.pharmacokinetics: No measured plasma, brain or tumor drug/metabolite concentration, bioavailability, free fraction or exposure-response relationship. tdTomato fluorescence measures tumor reporter, not curcumin. Brain tumor outcome is functional in-vivo evidence, but cannot itself quantify BBB penetration or identify the active chemical reaching tumor.
limits.toxicity: No body-weight trajectory, organ weights, histopathology, blood counts/chemistry, normal developmental or neurological testing, maximum tolerated dose or adverse-event table. Weight-loss euthanasia criteria are monitoring rules, not a demonstrated absence of toxicity.
limits.normal_cells: No normal-cell dose comparison in this 2011 study; do not import the 2012 MDCK panel or earlier clinical-safety citations as measured outcomes here.
limits.clinical: No human trial, pediatric treatment, MVA cohort, RMS model or consumer supplement equivalence. Background clinical/spice safety statements are citations, not this study’s measured safety data.
limits.mechanism: HDAC4/tubulin changes accompany antitumor effects; sole-target causality and purified biochemical selectivity are not established. Cdc27/BubR1/BUB1B restoration was not tested in this 2011 study.
limits.combination: Discussion proposes combinations with chemotherapy/irradiation but does not test a therapeutic combination in these mice.

2012_link_and_overlap.2012_evidence: 2012 cites this 2011 survival/xenograft study and shows Smo/Smo tumor Cdc27 blots using samples from mice treated as previously described; it reports lower Cdc27 and no detected high-MW crosslinked species.
2012_link_and_overlap.overlap_limit: No animal identifiers, specimen IDs or explicit cohort map establish which individual 2011 animals supplied the 2012 blot lanes. Treat as linked prior-protocol/tumor-sample evidence, with no demonstrated independent new efficacy cohort. Do not claim all lanes are proven identical specimens.
2012_link_and_overlap.credit_rule: The 2012 biochemical followup is not independent replication of the 2011 tumor-growth or survival endpoints. This qualification resolves the original primary; it adds no automatically admitted abstract record or new drug identity.

source_issues.detail: Methods 1 mg/kg versus main/supplement captions 1 g/kg; unresolved 1000-fold difference.
Methods hairless SCID versus captions nude.
Supplement 5 stars correspond to explicit P values >.05, not conventional significant thresholds.
Methods 3 h versus Figure 5A caption/Results 6 h.
D431 in portions of Results versus D341 in Methods/native supplements.
Reported final control mean exceeds declared 2000 mm³ euthanasia threshold; animal-level removal/accounting not reported.

strongest_positive: A significant Smo/Smo lifespan/clinical-endpoint extension and significant main DAOY xenograft tumor-volume reduction are genuine drug-assigned in-vivo positives, accompanied by tumor HDAC4/tubulin/apoptotic changes. The supplementary xenograft contrasts remain nonsignificant as printed.
BUB1B_MVA_assessment: The study strengthens ordinary curcumin’s tumor-control evidence. It does not establish BUB1B restoration, healthy division, muscle output or MVA/RMS benefit. Actual spindle disruption at 20 µM requires preserving the antimitotic direction. A timing/mitotic mechanism can remain a testable hypothesis without converting tumor killing into normal-cell compensation or assuming harm in untested MVA tissues.
relative_priority: Retain the real preclinical tumor benefit under the same no-MVA-proof standard used for provisional niacin/apitegromab. This source supports an antitumor reserve/comparator, not a demonstrated restoration or normal-function route; it does not resolve the competing nominees.
bounded_followups: Resolve the 1 mg/kg versus1 g/kg dose, exact host identity and Smo/Smo regimen through an authoritative correction or original study records before quantitative exposure translation.
Obtain animal-level assignment, censoring/endpoint and safety data if using this as a reproducible regimen or estimating therapeutic window.
Do not claim specimen overlap or independent replication without a 2011-to-2012 animal/sample map.
